Reviewed financing, cash-flow, and functional expense disclosures. Aggregate expenses do not establish the claimed subscription-level subsidy or its magnitude; research, free-service costs, and paid-service costs require different treatment.
Search lead concerns a gross-margin projection. It was not used as evidence of realized product costs or subsidies.
